'''Radley''' (Japanese: '''ラウル''' ''Raul'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]''. He participated in the [[Vertress Conference]] and was [[Stephan]]'s first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament.
